from pathlib import Path
import csv,hashlib,json,subprocess
root=Path.cwd();p=root/'udt_interframe_clock_network_2026-09-28'
launch=json.loads((p/'LAUNCH.json').read_text())
maintained={'LIVE.md','HANDOFF.md','CURRENT_RESEARCH_PROGRAM.md','MEMORY.md','INDEX.md','UDT_RESEARCH_ROADMAP.md'}
def pins(base,d):
 for f,h in d.items(): assert hashlib.sha256((base/f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h,f
pins(root,{f:h for f,h in launch['source_pins'].items() if f not in maintained})
freeze=json.loads((p/'CANDIDATE_FREEZE.json').read_text());pins(p,freeze['candidate_and_checks'])
for name,base in [('SOURCE_FIRST_SEAL.json',p/'review'),('DIRECT_CHECKS_SEAL.json',p/'review'),('DIRECT_REVIEW_SEAL.json',p)]:
 pins(base,json.loads((p/'review'/name).read_text())['sha256'])
rows={r['premise_id']:r for r in csv.DictReader((root/'CURRENT_SCIENTIFIC_PREMISES.tsv').open(),delimiter='\t')}
assert len(rows)==406
selected=json.loads((p/'SCOPED_REGISTRY.json').read_text());assert all(rows[r['premise_id']]==r for r in selected)
def git(*a):return subprocess.check_output(['git','-c','core.preloadIndex=false','-c','index.threads=1',*a],text=True).strip()
assert git('branch','--show-current')=='grok'
assert git('rev-parse','HEAD')==git('rev-parse','origin/grok')==launch['head']
assert set(git('diff','--name-only').splitlines())==maintained
assert not git('diff','--cached','--name-only') and not git('diff','--check')
u=set(git('ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard').splitlines());assert {f for f in u if not f.startswith(p.name+'/')}==set(launch['prior_untracked_paths'])
addition='Charles explicitly accepts measured c_E and G_obs as inputs (2026-09-28),\nreaffirming their OBSERVED anchor status. Neither must be derived before use;\nusing them for calibration does not by itself select an intrinsic physical scale.\n\n'
old=git('show',launch['head']+':CURRENT_RESEARCH_PROGRAM.md').split('## Current next gate')[0]
new=(root/'CURRENT_RESEARCH_PROGRAM.md').read_text().split('## Current next gate')[0]
assert new.count(addition)==1 and new.replace(addition,'')==old
size=sum(f.stat().st_size for f in p.rglob('*') if f.is_file());assert size<2*1024**2,size
print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS','scope':'source/preservation correspondence, not scientific proof','registry_rows_unchanged':406,'scoped_rows_verified':len(selected),'prior_untracked_paths_preserved':len(launch['prior_untracked_paths']),'protected_payloads_read_or_hashed':False,'candidate_initial_failure_and_repaired_checks_pinned':True,'three_review_seals_verified':True,'founding_opening_only_authorized_calibration_clarification':True,'maintained':sorted(maintained),'package_bytes':size},indent=2))
